::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Novr 22d [1852]  
**From:** Otterbourn  
**Manuscript:** MS Huntington Library: Yonge Letters
:::

My dear [Madam](people/person_1243.qmd),
The wreaths for these autumn months have been so much smaller that I am sorry to say that there is [only 7/6](organizations/other_102.qmd) to send you for this quarter, and here are P.O. stamps to that amount. I have not yet heard what we shall be able to do next year. I think that '[the Lesser Holydays](other_books/otherbook_234.qmd)’ is the name that best approves itself to me, what do you think of it. I know the poem of [Mary Howitt](people/person_1729.qmd)’s you mention, but we have it not in the house nor do I know where I read it.  If ever I come on it I will send it to you.

With many thanks for your [Garland](other_books/otherbook_225.qmd), which has been one of the choicest possessions of this years [Packet](organizations/other_52.qmd)

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge
